s: Ahura Mazda establishes Ardvi Sûra Anâhita (to keep the whole of the holy creation)
q: Ahura Mazda has established me to keep the whole of the holy creation.

s: Zarathustra is master of material world
q: Ahura Mazda has established thee as the master of the material world

s: Hukairya is a height (of the deep precipices, made of gold)
q: I will worship the height Hukairya, of the deep precipices, made of gold

s: Ardvi Sûra Anâhita leaps from Hukairya (from a hundred times the height of a man)
q: wherefrom this mine Ardvi Sûra Anâhita leaps, from a hundred times the height of a man

s: Ardvi Sûra Anâhita is worshipped by Hvôvas
q: the Hvôvas did worship her

s: Ardvi Sûra Anâhita grants that boon
q: Ardvi Sûra Anâhita granted him that boon

s: Ardvi Sûra Anâhita is worshipped by Naotaras
q: the Naotaras did worship her

s: Kavi Vîstâspa is a Naotaride (the lord of the swiftest horses in these countries)
q: quickly became Vîstâspa, the Naotaride, the lord of the swiftest horses in these countries

s: Zarathustra offers sacrifice at Airyana Vaêgah (by the good river Dâitya)
q: Unto her did the holy Zarathustra offer up a sacrifice in the Airyana Vaêgah, by the good river Dâitya

s: Kavi Vîstâspa is son of Aurvat-aspa (the valiant Kavi)
q: that I may bring the son of Aurvat-aspa, the valiant Kavi Vîstâspa

s: Ardvi Sûra Anâhita grants Kavi Vîstâspa (the boon of overcoming Tãthravant, Peshana, and Aregat-aspa)
q: Ardvi Sûra Anâhita granted him that boon, as he was offering up libations, giving gifts, sacrificing, and entreating that she would grant him that boon.

s: Ardvi Sûra Anâhita grants Zairi-vairi (the boon of overcoming Peshô-Kangha, Humâyaka, and Aregat-aspa)
q: Ardvi Sûra Anâhita granted him that boon, as he was offering up libations, giving gifts, sacrificing, and entreating that she would grant him that boon.

s: Aregat-aspa is denied favour (by Ardvi Sûra Anâhita)
q: Ardvi Sûra Anâhita did not grant them that favour

s: Vandaremaini offers sacrifice with Aregat-aspa (by the sea Vouru-Kasha)
q: Unto her did Aregat-aspa and Vandaremaini offer up a sacrifice by the sea Vouru-Kasha

s: Daêvas receive libations (after the sun has set)
q: six hundred and a thousand Daêvas, who ought not to receive that sacrifice, receive those libations that men bring unto me after [the sun has set].

s: Ardvi Sûra Anâhita stands waiting for man (one who will offer her libations and prayers)
q: She stands, the good Ardvi Sûra Anâhita, wearing a golden mantle, waiting for a man who shall offer her libations and prayers

s: Ardvi Sûra Anâhita is beneficent most beneficent
q: Grant me this, O good, most beneficent Ardvi Sûra Anâhita!

s: Ardvi Sûra Anâhita keeps holy creation (the whole of it)
q: Ahura Mazda has established me to keep the whole of the holy creation.

s: Ardvi Sûra Anâhita is carried forth in the shape of maid (fair of body, most strong, tall-formed, high-girded, pure, nobly born of a glorious race)
q: Ardvi Sûra Anâhita, who stands carried forth in the shape of a maid, fair of body, most strong, tall-formed, high-girded, pure, nobly born of a glorious race

s: Ardvi Sûra Anâhita wears golden mantle (fully embroidered with gold)
q: wearing along her . . . . a mantle fully embroidered with gold

s: Ardvi Sûra Anâhita wears beaver garments (made from the skins of thirty beavers)
q: She is clothed with garments of beaver, Ardvi Sûra Anâhita; with the skin of thirty beavers of those that bear four young ones

s: Ardvi Sûra Anâhita has a thousand cells and a thousand channels
q: Who has a thousand cells and a thousand channels: the extent of each of those cells, of each of those channels, is as much as a man can ride in forty days, riding on a good horse.

s: the law of holiness is a law (the law of the Lord)
q: The will of the Lord is the law of holiness.

s: heavenly Yazatas are a Yazatas (heavenly)
q: then up stand the heavenly Yazatas, by hundreds and thousands

s: heavenly Yazatas are numerous hundreds and thousands
q: then up stand the heavenly Yazatas, by hundreds and thousands

s: heavenly Yazatas gather Glory (from the sun)
q: they gather together its Glory

s: heavenly Yazatas pour Glory (upon the earth made by Ahura)
q: they pour its Glory upon the earth made by Ahura

s: the earth made by Mazda is a earth (made by Ahura)
q: the earth, made by Ahura, becomes clean

s: the earth made by Mazda becomes clean (when the sun rises)
q: And when the sun rises up, then the earth, made by Ahura, becomes clean

s: waters that run along the earth becomes clean
q: the running waters become clean

s: Daêvas is a beings born of darkness
q: to withstand the Daêvas born of darkness

s: standing waters becomes clean
q: the standing waters become clean

s: Karshvares contains all the things
q: all the things that are in the seven Karshvares

s: darkness is opposed by sacrifice (of the undying, shining, swift-horsed Sun)
q: to withstand darkness

s: robbers and bandits is opposed by sacrifice (of the undying, shining, swift-horsed Sun)
q: to withstand the robbers and bandits

s: Yâtus is opposed by sacrifice (of the undying, shining, swift-horsed Sun)
q: to withstand the Yâtus and Pairikas

s: Pairikas is opposed by sacrifice (of the undying, shining, swift-horsed Sun)
q: to withstand the Yâtus and Pairikas

s: Daêvas destroy Karshvares (if the sun does not rise)
q: Should not the sun rise up, then the Daêvas would destroy all the things that are in the seven Karshvares

s: Amesha-Spentas receive sacrifice (offered to them)
q: offers it up to the Amesha-Spentas

s: soul receives sacrifice (offered to it)
q: offers it up to his own soul

s: Mithra is a lord of wide pastures
q: I will sacrifice unto Mithra, the lord of wide pastures

s: Mithra has a thousand ears
q: who has a thousand ears, ten thousand eyes

s: Mithra has ten thousand eyes
q: who has a thousand ears, ten thousand eyes

s: club of Mithra is a club (of Mithra, the lord of wide pastures)
q: I will sacrifice unto the club of Mithra, the lord of wide pastures

s: friendship between the moon and the sun reigns between Moon that keeps in it the seed of the Bull (and the sun)
q: that reigns between the moon and the sun

s: Daêvas are opposed by heavenly Yazatas (in the material world)
q: nor would the heavenly Yazatas find any way of withstanding or repelling them in the material world

s: friendship between the moon and the sun reigns between undying, shining, swift-horsed Sun (and the moon)
q: that reigns between the moon and the sun

s: sacrifice is offered to Ahura Mazda (unto the undying, shining, swift-horsed Sun)
q: offers it up to Ahura Mazda

s: sacrifice is offered to Amesha-Spentas (unto the undying, shining, swift-horsed Sun)
q: offers it up to the Amesha-Spentas

s: sacrifice is offered to soul (unto the undying, shining, swift-horsed Sun)
q: offers it up to his own soul

s: sacrifice includes libations (offered unto the undying, shining, swift-horsed Sun)
q: Unto the undying, shining, swift-horsed Sun we offer up the libations, the Haoma and meat, the baresma, the wisdom of the tongue, the holy spells, the speech, the deeds, the libations, and the rightly-spoken words.

s: sacrifice includes Haoma (offered unto the undying, shining, swift-horsed Sun)
q: Unto the undying, shining, swift-horsed Sun we offer up the libations, the Haoma and meat, the baresma, the wisdom of the tongue, the holy spells, the speech, the deeds, the libations, and the rightly-spoken words.

s: sacrifice includes meat (offered unto the undying, shining, swift-horsed Sun)
q: Unto the undying, shining, swift-horsed Sun we offer up the libations, the Haoma and meat, the baresma, the wisdom of the tongue, the holy spells, the speech, the deeds, the libations, and the rightly-spoken words.

s: sacrifice includes baresma (offered unto the undying, shining, swift-horsed Sun)
q: Unto the undying, shining, swift-horsed Sun we offer up the libations, the Haoma and meat, the baresma, the wisdom of the tongue, the holy spells, the speech, the deeds, the libations, and the rightly-spoken words.

s: sacrifice includes wisdom of the tongue (offered unto the undying, shining, swift-horsed Sun)
q: Unto the undying, shining, swift-horsed Sun we offer up the libations, the Haoma and meat, the baresma, the wisdom of the tongue, the holy spells, the speech, the deeds, the libations, and the rightly-spoken words.

s: sacrifice includes holy spells (offered unto the undying, shining, swift-horsed Sun)
q: Unto the undying, shining, swift-horsed Sun we offer up the libations, the Haoma and meat, the baresma, the wisdom of the tongue, the holy spells, the speech, the deeds, the libations, and the rightly-spoken words.

s: undying, shining, swift-horsed Sun is a Sun
q: Unto the undying, shining, swift-horsed Sun

s: sacrifice includes speech (offered unto the undying, shining, swift-horsed Sun)
q: Unto the undying, shining, swift-horsed Sun we offer up the libations, the Haoma and meat, the baresma, the wisdom of the tongue, the holy spells, the speech, the deeds, the libations, and the rightly-spoken words.

s: sacrifice includes deeds (offered unto the undying, shining, swift-horsed Sun)
q: Unto the undying, shining, swift-horsed Sun we offer up the libations, the Haoma and meat, the baresma, the wisdom of the tongue, the holy spells, the speech, the deeds, the libations, and the rightly-spoken words.

s: sacrifice includes rightly-spoken words (offered unto the undying, shining, swift-horsed Sun)
q: Unto the undying, shining, swift-horsed Sun we offer up the libations, the Haoma and meat, the baresma, the wisdom of the tongue, the holy spells, the speech, the deeds, the libations, and the rightly-spoken words.

s: Yathâ ahû vairyô is a prayer (a formula declaring the will of the Lord to be the law of holiness)
q: Yathâ ahû vairyô: The will of the Lord is the law of holiness.

s: undying, shining, swift-horsed Sun has attribute undying
q: We sacrifice unto the undying, shining, swift-horsed Sun.

s: undying, shining, swift-horsed Sun has attribute shining
q: We sacrifice unto the undying, shining, swift-horsed Sun.

s: undying, shining, swift-horsed Sun has attribute swift-horsed
q: We sacrifice unto the undying, shining, swift-horsed Sun.

s: the law of holiness is a the best of all good
q: Ashem Vohû: Holiness is the best of all good . . . .

s: Moon that keeps in it the seed of the Bull is glorious
q: I will sacrifice unto the Moon, that keeps in it the seed of the Bull, the liberal, bright, glorious, water-giving, warmth-giving, wisdom-giving, wealth-giving, riches-giving, thoughtfulness-giving, weal-giving, freshness-giving, prosperity-giving, the liberal, the healing.

s: Moon that keeps in it the seed of the Bull is water-giving
q: I will sacrifice unto the Moon, that keeps in it the seed of the Bull, the liberal, bright, glorious, water-giving, warmth-giving, wisdom-giving, wealth-giving, riches-giving, thoughtfulness-giving, weal-giving, freshness-giving, prosperity-giving, the liberal, the healing.

s: Moon that keeps in it the seed of the Bull is warmth-giving
q: I will sacrifice unto the Moon, that keeps in it the seed of the Bull, the liberal, bright, glorious, water-giving, warmth-giving, wisdom-giving, wealth-giving, riches-giving, thoughtfulness-giving, weal-giving, freshness-giving, prosperity-giving, the liberal, the healing.

s: Moon that keeps in it the seed of the Bull is wisdom-giving
q: I will sacrifice unto the Moon, that keeps in it the seed of the Bull, the liberal, bright, glorious, water-giving, warmth-giving, wisdom-giving, wealth-giving, riches-giving, thoughtfulness-giving, weal-giving, freshness-giving, prosperity-giving, the liberal, the healing.

s: Moon that keeps in it the seed of the Bull is wealth-giving
q: I will sacrifice unto the Moon, that keeps in it the seed of the Bull, the liberal, bright, glorious, water-giving, warmth-giving, wisdom-giving, wealth-giving, riches-giving, thoughtfulness-giving, weal-giving, freshness-giving, prosperity-giving, the liberal, the healing.

s: Moon that keeps in it the seed of the Bull is riches-giving
q: I will sacrifice unto the Moon, that keeps in it the seed of the Bull, the liberal, bright, glorious, water-giving, warmth-giving, wisdom-giving, wealth-giving, riches-giving, thoughtfulness-giving, weal-giving, freshness-giving, prosperity-giving, the liberal, the healing.

s: Moon that keeps in it the seed of the Bull is thoughtfulness-giving
q: I will sacrifice unto the Moon, that keeps in it the seed of the Bull, the liberal, bright, glorious, water-giving, warmth-giving, wisdom-giving, wealth-giving, riches-giving, thoughtfulness-giving, weal-giving, freshness-giving, prosperity-giving, the liberal, the healing.

s: Moon that keeps in it the seed of the Bull is weal-giving
q: I will sacrifice unto the Moon, that keeps in it the seed of the Bull, the liberal, bright, glorious, water-giving, warmth-giving, wisdom-giving, wealth-giving, riches-giving, thoughtfulness-giving, weal-giving, freshness-giving, prosperity-giving, the liberal, the healing.

s: Moon that keeps in it the seed of the Bull is freshness-giving
q: I will sacrifice unto the Moon, that keeps in it the seed of the Bull, the liberal, bright, glorious, water-giving, warmth-giving, wisdom-giving, wealth-giving, riches-giving, thoughtfulness-giving, weal-giving, freshness-giving, prosperity-giving, the liberal, the healing.

s: Moon that keeps in it the seed of the Bull is prosperity-giving
q: I will sacrifice unto the Moon, that keeps in it the seed of the Bull, the liberal, bright, glorious, water-giving, warmth-giving, wisdom-giving, wealth-giving, riches-giving, thoughtfulness-giving, weal-giving, freshness-giving, prosperity-giving, the liberal, the healing.

s: Moon that keeps in it the seed of the Bull keeps in it the seed of the Bull
q: Unto the Moon that keeps in it the seed of the Bull; unto the only-created Bull and unto the Bull of many species;

s: Moon that keeps in it the seed of the Bull is healing
q: I will sacrifice unto the Moon, that keeps in it the seed of the Bull, the liberal, bright, glorious, water-giving, warmth-giving, wisdom-giving, wealth-giving, riches-giving, thoughtfulness-giving, weal-giving, freshness-giving, prosperity-giving, the liberal, the healing.

s: Moon that keeps in it the seed of the Bull receives libations
q: Unto the Moon that keeps in it the seed of the Bull, we offer up the libations, the Haoma and meat, the baresma, the wisdom of the tongue, the holy spells, the speech, the deeds, the libations, and the rightly-spoken words.

s: Moon that keeps in it the seed of the Bull receives Haoma
q: Unto the Moon that keeps in it the seed of the Bull, we offer up the libations, the Haoma and meat, the baresma, the wisdom of the tongue, the holy spells, the speech, the deeds, the libations, and the rightly-spoken words.

s: Moon that keeps in it the seed of the Bull receives meat
q: Unto the Moon that keeps in it the seed of the Bull, we offer up the libations, the Haoma and meat, the baresma, the wisdom of the tongue, the holy spells, the speech, the deeds, the libations, and the rightly-spoken words.

s: Moon that keeps in it the seed of the Bull receives baresma
q: Unto the Moon that keeps in it the seed of the Bull, we offer up the libations, the Haoma and meat, the baresma, the wisdom of the tongue, the holy spells, the speech, the deeds, the libations, and the rightly-spoken words.

s: Moon that keeps in it the seed of the Bull receives holy spells
q: Unto the Moon that keeps in it the seed of the Bull, we offer up the libations, the Haoma and meat, the baresma, the wisdom of the tongue, the holy spells, the speech, the deeds, the libations, and the rightly-spoken words.

s: Moon that keeps in it the seed of the Bull receives speech
q: Unto the Moon that keeps in it the seed of the Bull, we offer up the libations, the Haoma and meat, the baresma, the wisdom of the tongue, the holy spells, the speech, the deeds, the libations, and the rightly-spoken words.

s: Moon that keeps in it the seed of the Bull receives deeds
q: Unto the Moon that keeps in it the seed of the Bull, we offer up the libations, the Haoma and meat, the baresma, the wisdom of the tongue, the holy spells, the speech, the deeds, the libations, and the rightly-spoken words.

s: Amesha-Spentas pour Glory (upon the earth made by Mazda)
q: the Amesha-Spentas stand up, pouring its glory upon the earth, made by Mazda.

s: Ahura Mazda creates the earth made by Mazda
q: the Amesha-Spentas stand up, pouring its glory upon the earth, made by Mazda.

s: Moon that keeps in it the seed of the Bull is a holy
q: We sacrifice unto the Moon that keeps in it the seed of the Bull, the holy and master of holiness.

s: Moon that keeps in it the seed of the Bull is a master of holiness
q: We sacrifice unto the Moon that keeps in it the seed of the Bull, the holy and master of holiness.

s: Moon that keeps in it the seed of the Bull waxes for fifteen days
q: For fifteen days does the moon wax; for fifteen days does the moon wane.

s: Moon that keeps in it the seed of the Bull wanes for fifteen days
q: For fifteen days does the moon wax; for fifteen days does the moon wane.

s: Moon that keeps in it the seed of the Bull causes golden-hued plants to grow (when its light waxes warmer)
q: And when the light of the moon waxes warmer, golden-hued plants grow on from the earth during the spring.

s: Moon that keeps in it the seed of the Bull is liberal
q: I will sacrifice unto the Moon, that keeps in it the seed of the Bull, the liberal, bright, glorious, water-giving, warmth-giving, wisdom-giving, wealth-giving, riches-giving, thoughtfulness-giving, weal-giving, freshness-giving, prosperity-giving, the liberal, the healing.

s: Moon that keeps in it the seed of the Bull is bright
q: I will sacrifice unto the Moon, that keeps in it the seed of the Bull, the liberal, bright, glorious, water-giving, warmth-giving, wisdom-giving, wealth-giving, riches-giving, thoughtfulness-giving, weal-giving, freshness-giving, prosperity-giving, the liberal, the healing.

s: Ahura Mazda is a Maker of the material world (holy and most beneficent Spirit)
q: Ahura Mazda, most beneficent Spirit, Maker of the material world, thou Holy One!

s: Tistrya is a lord of a thousand boons (healthful, wise, happy, and powerful)
q: We sacrifice unto Tistrya, the bright and glorious star, the healthful, wise, happy, and powerful, who is the lord of a thousand boons, and grants many boons to that man who has pleased him, whether begging or not begging for them.

s: Tistrya grants wealth of male children (to those who offer libations with Haoma and holy meat)
q: Who now will offer me the libations with the Haoma and the holy meat? To whom shall I give wealth of male children, a troop of male children, and the purification of his own soul? Now I ought to receive sacrifice and prayer in the material world, by the law of excellent holiness.

s: Tistrya grants wealth of oxen (in bull form to those who offer libations with Haoma and holy meat)
q: Who now will offer me the libations with the Haoma and the holy meat? To whom shall I give wealth of oxen, a herd of oxen, and the purification of his own soul? Now I ought to receive sacrifice and prayer in the material world, by the law of excellent holiness.

s: Tistrya grants wealth of horses (in horse form to those who offer libations with Haoma and holy meat)
q: Who now will offer me the libations with the Haoma and the holy meat? To whom shall I give wealth of horses, a troop of horses, and the purification of his own soul? Now I ought to receive sacrifice and prayer in the material world, by the law of excellent holiness.

s: Tistrya has eye sight sound
q: We sacrifice unto Tistrya, whose eye-sight is sound.

s: Tistrya moves along watery way (from the shining east, along the path made by the gods)
q: We sacrifice unto Tistrya, the bright and glorious star, who from the shining east, moves along his long winding course, along the path made by the gods, along the way appointed for him the watery way, at the will of Ahura Mazda, at the will of the Amesha-Spentas.

s: Tistrya is a white beautiful horse (with golden ears and a golden caparison)
q: Then, O Spitama Zarathustra! the bright and glorious Tistrya goes down to the sea Vouru-Kasha in the shape of a white, beautiful horse, with golden ears and a golden caparison.

s: Tistrya transforms into man of fifteen years of age (for ten nights; bright, clear-eyed, tall, strong, and clever)
q: For ten nights, O Spitama Zarathustra! Tistrya, the bright and glorious star, mingles his shape with light, moving in the shape of a man of fifteen years of age, bright, with clear eyes, tall, full of strength, strong, and clever.

s: Tistrya transforms into golden-horned bull (for the next ten nights)
q: The next ten nights, O Spitama Zarathustra! the bright and glorious Tistrya mingles his shape with light, moving in the shape of a golden-horned bull.

s: Tistrya transforms into white beautiful horse (for the next ten nights; with golden ears and a golden caparison)
q: The next ten nights, O Spitama Zarathustra! the bright and glorious Tistrya mingles his shape with light, moving in the shape of a white, beautiful horse, with golden ears and a golden caparison.

s: Ahura Mazda establishes Tistrya (as lord and overseer above all stars)
q: whom Ahura Mazda has established as a lord and overseer above all stars

s: Tistrya fights Daêva Apaosha (at Vouru-Kasha)
q: They meet together, hoof against hoof, O Spitama Zarathustra! the bright and glorious Tistrya and the Daêva Apaosha.

s: Tistrya overcomes Daêva Apaosha (after fighting until noon)
q: Then the bright and glorious Tistrya proves stronger than the Daêva Apaosha, he overcomes him.

s: Tistrya makes boil sea Vouru-Kasha (up and down and in all its shores and middle)
q: He makes the sea boil up and down; he makes the sea stream this and that way; he makes the sea flow this and that way: all the shores of the sea Vouru-Kasha are boiling over, all the middle of it is boiling over.

s: Tistrya drives back Pairikas (from Vouru-Kasha)
q: Tistrya afflicts them, he blows them away from the sea Vouru-Kasha;

s: Tistrya withstands Pairika Duzyâirya (keeping her in bonds)
q: But the bright and glorious Tistrya keeps that Pairika in bonds, with twofold bonds, with threefold bonds, that cannot be overcome, with bonds all over the body: it is as if there were a thousand men keeping one man in bonds, a thousand men of those who are the strongest in strength.

s: Daêva Apaosha is a Daêva (dark horse with black features and brands of terror)
q: But there rushes down to meet him the Daêva Apaosha, in the shape of a dark horse, black with black ears, black with a black back, black with a black tail, stamped with brands of terror.

s: Daêva Apaosha overcomes Tistrya (after fighting for three days and three nights)
q: And then the Daêva Apaosha proves stronger than the bright and glorious Tistrya, he overcomes him.

s: sea Vouru-Kasha is a sea (powerful, large-sized, deep, and salt-watered)
q: the sea Vouru-Kasha, the powerful sea, the large-sized, deep sea of salt waters.

s: sea Vouru-Kasha contains Mount Us-hindu (standing in its middle)
q: and vapours rise up above Mount Us-hindu, that stands in the middle of the sea Vouru-Kasha.

s: Ahura Mazda assists Erekhsha
q: For Ahura Mazda gave him assistance; so did the waters and the plants; and Mithra, the lord of wide pastures, opened a wide way unto him.

s: Satavaêsa makes flow standing waters (down to the seven Karshvares of the earth)
q: Then Satavaêsa makes those waters flow down to the seven Karshvares of the earth

s: Apãm Napât divides standing waters (amongst the countries in the material world)
q: Apãm Napât, O Spitama Zarathustra! divides the waters amongst the countries in the material world, in company with the mighty wind, the Glory, made by the waters, and the Fravashis of the faithful.

s: Mithra is a lord of wide pastures
q: and Mithra, the lord of wide pastures, opened a wide way unto him.

s: Aryan countries perform sacrifice and prayer (in honour of Tistrya and in the perfection of holiness)
q: If the Aryan countries, O Spitama Zarathustra! would perform in honour of the bright and glorious Tistrya the due sacrifice and invocation, just as that sacrifice and invocation ought to be performed in the perfection of holiness

s: the Law of the worshippers of Mazda is a law (excellent and governing sacrifice and prayer)
q: Now I ought to receive sacrifice and prayer in the material world, by the law of excellent holiness.

s: Ahura Mazda creates Tistrya (as worthy of sacrifice, prayer, propitiation, and glorification as Ahura Mazda)
q: I, O Spitama Zarathustra! have created that star Tistrya as worthy of sacrifice, as worthy of prayer, as worthy of propitiation, as worthy of glorification as myself, Ahura Mazda

s: Zarathustra is a worshipper of Mazda (follower of Zarathustra)
q: I confess myself a worshipper of Mazda, a follower of Zarathustra, one who hates the Daêvas and obeys the laws of Ahura;

s: Tistrya is a star (bright and glorious)
q: Unto Tistrya, the bright and glorious star

s: Tistrya is a seed of the waters (powerful, tall, and strong)
q: We sacrifice unto Tistrya, the bright and glorious star, who is the seed of the waters, powerful, tall, and strong, whose light goes afar;

s: Tistrya protects Moon that keeps in it the seed of the Bull
q: We worship the lordship and mastership [of Tistrya], whereby he protects the Moon, the dwelling, the food, when my glorious stars come along and impart their gifts to men.

s: Drvâspa yokes horses (in teams)
q: Who yokes teams of horses, who makes her chariot turn and its wheels sound

s: Drvâspa has chariot (whose wheels sound)
q: who makes her chariot turn and its wheels sound

s: Drvâspa grants boon (to faithful sacrificers who entreat her)
q: The powerful Drvâspa, made by Mazda, the holy Drvâspa, the maintainer, granted him that boon, as he was offering libations, giving gifts, sacrificing, and entreating that she would grant him that boon.

s: sacrifice is offered to her (for her brightness and glory)
q: For her brightness and glory, I will offer her a sacrifice worth being heard

s: prayer is a act of worship
q: I bless the sacrifice and prayer, and the strength and vigour of the powerful Drvâspa, made by Mazda and holy.

s: flocks is kept in health
q: who keeps the flocks in health, the herds in health, the grown-up (cattle) in health, the young ones in health

s: Haoshyangha, the Paradhâta is a Paradhâta
q: To her did Haoshyangha, the Paradhâta, offer up a sacrifice on the enclosure of the Hara

s: Haoshyangha, the Paradhâta offers sacrifice (on the enclosure of the Hara)
q: To her did Haoshyangha, the Paradhâta, offer up a sacrifice on the enclosure of the Hara, the beautiful height, made by Mazda, with a hundred male horses, a thousand oxen, and ten thousand lambs, and with an offering of libations

s: Yima Khshaêta is a good shepherd
q: To her did Yima Khshaêta, the good shepherd, offer up a sacrifice from the height Hukairya

s: Thraêtaona is a heir of the Âthwya clan (valiant)
q: To her did Thraêtaona, the heir of the valiant Âthwya clan, offer up a sacrifice in the four-cornered Varena

s: Angra Mainyu is a creator of the strongest Drug (against the material world)
q: that most powerful, fiendish Drug, that demon, baleful to the world, the strongest Drug that Angra Mainyu created against the material world, to destroy the world of the good principle

s: Drug is a Drug (three-mouthed, three-headed, six-eyed, and having a thousand senses)
q: that I may overcome Azi Dahâka, the three-mouthed, the three-headed, the six-eyed, who has a thousand senses, that most powerful, fiendish Drug, that demon, baleful to the world

s: Haoma is a enlivening and healing being (beautiful, lordly, with golden eyes)

s: Yasna I is a series of announcements, completions, sacrifices, homages, propitiations, and praises directed to Ahura Mazda and many holy beings and powers. It concerns the Good Mind, Righteousness the Best, the Fire of Ahura Mazda, Hâvani and other lords of the ritual order, Mithra, the Fravashis of the saints, and the Yazads. The speaker confesses himself a Mazda-worshipper of Zarathustra’s order and a foe to the Daêvas. He also confesses possible offenses by thought, word, or deed and makes up for any deficiency in his Yasna and homage.

l: the Yasna, Yasna, Yasna / Yasna I.
s: The Yasna is announced and completed to Ahura Mazda, many holy beings, the lords of the ritual order, and the Yazads. The speaker also confesses possible deficiencies in his Yasna and offers increased praise where he may have caused decrease.

l: Ahura Mazda, Yasna, Yasna / Yasna I.
s: Ahura Mazda is described as the Creator, radiant and glorious, greatest and best, wisest, and most perfect. He made, fashioned, nourished, and protected the speaker, made the waters, plants, mountains, and other creatures, and is repeatedly addressed in sacrifice, homage, propitiation, and praise.

l: Righteousness the Best, Yasna, Yasna / Yasna I.
s: Righteousness the Best is announced and celebrated as a recipient of the Yasna. It is identified with the best ritual order and with the lords of the ritual order.

l: Fire of Ahura Mazda, Yasna, Yasna / Yasna I.
s: The Fire of Ahura Mazda is announced and celebrated as a recipient of the Yasna. The speaker also announces the Fire together with all fires.

Hâvani is the holy lord of the ritual order and receives sacrifice, homage, propitiation, and praise. The speaker asks forgiveness if he has offended Hâvani and identifies Hâvani as the one around whom the thirty and three lords of the ritual order are arranged.
Mithra is described as lofty, everlasting, holy, wide-pastured, thousand-eared, and myriad-eyed. He is announced and celebrated in the Yasna as the Yazad of the spoken name and as the province-ruler.

l: Fravashis of the saints, Yasna, Yasna / Yasna I.
s: The Fravashis of the saints are announced and celebrated in the Yasna. They are described as redoubted and overwhelming evil, and the speaker includes the Fravashi of his own soul among those addressed.
Sraosha, identified with Obedience, is called blessed and endowed with blessed recompense. He is said to smite with victory and further the settlements.

l: Spenta Mainyu, Yasna, Yasna / Yasna I.
s: Spenta Mainyu is associated with the stars, which are described as his creatures. The holy male and female creatures of Spenta Mainyu are also included among the beings receiving the Yasna.

l: Zarathustrian revelation, Yasna, Yasna / Yasna I.
s: The Zarathustrian revelation is described as the Bounteous Mãthra, holy and effective, and as a revelation given against the Daêvas. It is announced and completed in the Yasna.

l: Mazdayasnian Faith, Yasna, Yasna / Yasna I.
s: The Mazdayasnian Faith is described as good and as having a long descent. It is included in the speaker’s announcements and completions of the Yasna.

l: three and thirty lords, Yasna, Yasna / Yasna I.
s: The lords of the ritual order include the day-lords, time periods, festivals, seasons, and many named holy beings. They are announced, celebrated, and addressed in sacrifice, homage, propitiation, and praise, and the speaker asks forgiveness for any offense against them.
The Yazads are described as beneficent beings who dispose of things aright, both heavenly and earthly. They are announced and completed to in the Yasna as beings fit for sacrifice and homage.
The Daêvas are opposed by the Zarathustrian revelation. The speaker declares himself a foe to the Daêvas and devoted to the lore of the Lord.
Zarathustra is associated with the order of the Mazda-worshipper and with the promulgation of the lords of the ritual order. The speaker declares himself a Mazda-worshipper of Zarathustra’s order.
The speaker confesses himself a Mazda-worshipper of Zarathustra’s order. He also declares himself a foe to the Daêvas and devoted to the lore of the Lord.

The ritual order is represented by Righteousness the Best and by its many holy lords. Its days, festivals, seasons, heavenly and earthly beings, and observances are included in the speaker’s Yasna and praise.

l: The Sacrifice, Yasna, Yasna / Yasna I.
s: Sacrifice is offered to Ahura Mazda, the lords of the ritual order, the Yazads, and other holy beings. The speaker repeatedly joins sacrifice with homage, propitiation, and praise.

The speaker repeatedly approaches the Zaothra and Baresman together with worship and praise. The unit invokes Ahura Mazda, the Bountiful Immortals, Mithra, the Fire, waters, plants, mountains, festivals, seasons, Fravashis, and all holy Yazads. It especially names the lords of the ritual order and their proper times, including Hâvani, Sâvanghi, Vîsya, and many others. Mithra is praised as having wide pastures, a thousand ears, and myriad eyes, while Ahura Mazda is praised as radiant and glorious and identified as the land-ruler.

The speaker desires to approach the Zaothra with worship and praise, both separately and conjointly with the Baresman. The Zaothra is used in approaching Ahura Mazda, Mithra, the lords of the ritual order, and many other holy beings and things.

The speaker desires to approach the Baresman with worship and praise, together with the Zaothra and conjoined with it. The Baresman is described as provided with its Zaothra and girdle and spread with sanctity.
Ahura Mazda is approached with praise in the Zaothra and Baresman as the holy lord of the ritual order. He is also called radiant and glorious, and is identified as the land-ruler.

l: three and thirty lords, Yasna, Yasna II.
s: The speaker approaches numerous lords of the ritual order with praise in the Zaothra and Baresman. They include the Bountiful Immortals, Asnya, Hâvani, Sâvanghi, Vîsya, Rapithwina, Frâdatfshu, Zantuma, Ushahina, and many others, including the three and thirty nearest round about the Hâvanis.

Mithra is approached with praise in the Zaothra and Baresman. He is described as having wide pastures, a thousand ears, and myriad eyes, as the Yazad of the spoken name, and as the governor of all the provinces.

Yasna III concerns the approach, praise, sacrifice, and propitiation of sacred beings, ritual objects, times, places, and creatures. It names offerings including the Baresman, Zaothra, Myazda, Haoma, Parahaoma, wood, water, milk, plants, and meat. It invokes Ahura Mazda, the Bountiful Immortals, Sraosha, the Fravashi of Spitâma Zarathustra, Fire, Mithra, Righteousness, and many other Yazads and ritual lords. It concludes with the Mazdayasnian confession and an exchange between the Zaotar and the Ratu concerning the proper priestly recitation.

Yasna III advances to the naming of the objects of propitiation. It sets out their approach, praise, sacrifice, homage, and propitiation, and concludes with a priestly exchange between the Zaotar and the Ratu.

The Baresman is brought to its appointed place with the Zaothra at the time of Hâvani. It is approached with praise, its binding and spreading being performed with sanctity for the propitiation of the Bountiful Immortals.
The Zaothra accompanies the Baresman when it is brought to its appointed place at Hâvani.

Hâvani is the time at which the Baresman and Zaothra are brought to their appointed place. Hâvani is also approached as a holy lord of the ritual order and is named among the ritual lords whose services were inculcated by Mazda and pronounced by Zarathustra.

Ahura Mazda receives propitiation through the Myazda-offering, fresh meat, and other sacred offerings. He is named with the Bountiful Immortals, is the father of Fire, created the good waters and plants, and gave the Religion, Kingly Glory, and other benefits.

The Bountiful Immortals are among those for whose propitiation the Myazda-offering, fresh meat, and the Baresman with the Zaothra are approached. They are also named among the holy beings approached with praise.

Sraosha is identified with Obedience and is described as blessed, holy, victorious in smiting, and causing the settlements to advance. He receives propitiation through offerings including meat and sacred flesh, and is approached with a Yast.

Haoma and Parahaoma are approached with praise for the propitiation of the Fravashi of Spitâma Zarathustra. Haoma is also approached with praise for the propitiation of the good waters which Mazda created, and both Haoma and Haoma-juice are approached with a Yast.

l: Fravashi of Zarathustra Spitâma, Yasna, Yasna III.
s: The Fravashi of Spitâma Zarathustra is the object of propitiation when Haoma and Parahaoma, and later Haoma and Haoma-juice, are approached with praise or a Yast.
Spitâma Zarathustra is identified as a saint. His Fravashi is propitiated through the approach to Haoma and Parahaoma.
Fire is called the son of Ahura Mazda and the Yazad of the spoken name. Sacred wood and wood-billets are approached with perfume and praise or a Yast for Fire's propitiation.

The Ratu is a holy lord of the ritual order and is associated with exact regulation. At the conclusion, the Ratu responds to the Zaotar and is called upon to speak forth from his Righteousness, holy and learned.

Mithra is approached together with Ahura as one of the lofty and imperishable two. He is also named as Mithra of the wide pastures, with a thousand ears and myriad eyes, and as province-lord of the provinces.

l: Righteousness the Best, Yasna, Yasna III.
s: Righteousness the Best is approached with praise in connection with Rapithwina. It is named among the Lords of Asha called Vahishta, whose services were inculcated by Mazda and pronounced by Zarathustra.

l: Fravashis of the saints, Yasna, Yasna III.
s: The Fravashis of the saints are approached with Yasts. They are described as mighty and overwhelming, and are associated with the saints, those who held to the ancient lore, and those of the next of kin.

l: three and thirty lords of the ritual order, Yasna, Yasna III.
s: The Lords of Asha called Vahishta approach nearest at the time of Hâvani. Their services were inculcated by Mazda and pronounced by Zarathustra as the feasts of Righteousness, the Best.
The Daêvas are opposed by the Mazdayasnian confession. The Zarathustrian law is described as composed against them.
Righteousness is named as the lofty lord who is itself the essence of the ritual. The Ratu is called upon to speak from his Righteousness.

The Mazdayasnian confesses himself to be of Zarathustra's order and a foe to the Daêvas. He is devoted to the lore of the Lord and to the sacrifice, homage, propitiation, and praise of the ritual lords and regulators.

The Zaotar brings or presides over the Baresman and Zaothra ritual and speaks in the concluding exchange. He asks the Ratu to speak forth and is then told to speak forth as the Ahû to be revered and chosen.

The unit concerns the offering of good thoughts, good words, good deeds, ritual substances, prayers, recitations, and praises through celebrations. These offerings are presented to Ahura Mazda, Sraosha, the Bountiful Immortals, the Fravashis of the saints, Fire, and many other holy beings and entities. The offerings are declared beneficial for the house, its herds, its people, and those yet to be born. The unit concludes by worshipping the Bountiful Immortals, the superior male and female beings known to Ahura Mazda, and all good Yazads fit for sacrifice, homage, propitiation, and praise.

l: The Offering Takes Place, Yasna, Yasna IV.
s: The Offering Takes Place through celebrations in which offerings, prayers, recitations, and praises are announced and presented to holy beings.
Good thoughts are offered and presented in the celebrations as offerings to holy beings.
Good words are offered and presented in the celebrations as offerings to holy beings.
Good deeds are offered and presented in the celebrations as offerings to holy beings.
Haomas are included among the offerings announced and presented in the celebrations.
Celebrations are used to announce and present offerings to Ahura Mazda and many holy beings.
Ahura Mazda receives the offerings for sacrifice, homage, propitiation, and praise. He is identified as the Creator, radiant and glorious, and as the one who knows the superior service of beings.
Sraosha receives offerings and is called blessed and mighty, with the Mãthra as his body. He is also described as having a daring spear, furthering settlements, and smiting with the blow of victory.
The Bountiful Immortals receive offerings for sacrifice, homage, propitiation, and praise. They are described as ruling and disposing of all aright, and as dwelling with the Good Mind.

l: Fravashis of the saints, Yasna, Yasna IV.
s: The Fravashis of the saints receive offerings and are described as mighty and overwhelming for the succour of the saints.

l: Fire of Ahura Mazda, Yasna, Yasna IV.
s: Fire of Ahura Mazda receives offerings for sacrifice, homage, propitiation, and praise and is called the lofty lord of the entire creation of the holy.
Fire, called Ahura Mazda's son, receives offerings for sacrifice, homage, propitiation, and praise, together with all the fires.
The house and its furtherance are said to benefit from the offerings, along with its herds, men, those now born, and those yet to be born.

l: Day-lords of the ritual order, Yasna, Yasna IV.
s: The Day-lords of the ritual order receive offerings for sacrifice, homage, propitiation, and praise. They include Hâvani, Sâvanghi, Vîsya, Rapithwina, Uzayêirina, Aiwisrûthrima, and Ushahina.

l: Mithra, province-lord of the provinces, Yasna, Yasna IV.
s: Mithra of the wide pastures receives offerings for sacrifice, homage, propitiation, and praise. He is described as having a thousand ears and a myriad eyes and as the Yazad of the spoken name.

l: Righteousness the Best, Yasna, Yasna IV.
s: Righteousness the Best receives offerings and is associated with the holy lords of the ritual order and Ahura Mazda's Fire.

l: Month-lords of the ritual order, Yasna, Yasna IV.
s: The Month-lords of the ritual order receive offerings for sacrifice, homage, propitiation, and praise. They include the new moon, the waning moon, and the full moon which scatters night.
The Yearly festivals receive offerings for sacrifice, homage, propitiation, and praise. They include Maidhyô-zaremaya, Maidhyô-shema, Patishahya, Ayâthrima, Maidhyâirya, and Hamaspathmaêdhaya.
Mãthra Spenta is announced and presented as holy and effective, as the law against the Daêvas and the Zarathustrian statute.
